Kerala to issue stray dog euthanasia protocol

The Kerala government will issue a protocol for the euthanasia of stray dogs before August 7, according to a minister. This decision follows a High Court directive stating that victims of stray dog attacks can claim damages from panchayats for failing to perform their statutory duties. The court emphasized the panchayats' responsibility to control stray dog populations.
